name: Aurora Bed and Breakfast
accommodation: Two en-suite rooms (Orkney and Shetland) set up as twin or super king; extra single bed in Shetland
confirmedFeatures: Locally sourced breakfast, free Wi-Fi, tea and coffee, travel cots and high chairs
overview: Aurora is a small bed and breakfast at Murkle, roughly four miles east of Thurso, looking over the Pentland Firth to Dunnet Head and Orkney. Its two en-suite rooms convert between twin and super king, and one takes an extra bed for families. Breakfast uses local produce, and dogs are welcome.
surfTripFit: It suits a dog-friendly trip, with Thurso's beach and Dunnet Bay both a short drive away.
